Having considered Plaintiff's motion for a preliminary injunction and the papers in support and opposition, the Court finds that Plaintiff has shown a likelihood of success on the merits, irreparable harm absent an order, that the balance of hardships favors Plaintiff, and that the public interest favors the order.

IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that:

1. The motion is GRANTED.

2. Defendant, her officers, agents, employees, and successors in office shall restore Plaintiff's access to the account at [[ACCOUNT URL]] within seven (7) days of the date of this Order.

3. Defendant, her officers, agents, employees, and successors in office shall refrain, during the pendency of this action, from blocking Plaintiff from the Account and from enforcing against Plaintiff any policy or practice of blocking users because of the viewpoints those users express.

4. Nothing in this Order requires Defendant to follow or reply to Plaintiff, or to permit content that violates the platform's terms of service or that consists of threats, harassment, or disclosure of personal information.

5. No security is required under Rule 65(c).

6. This Order remains in effect until final judgment or further order of the Court.

<p class="sig keep" style="margin-top:8pt">SO ORDERED.<br><br>Dated: [[DATE]]<br><br>________________________________________<br>United States District Judge</p>
